att_help: Before the start, tick the teams that came, correct the number of players and update photos or mottos. Then place every team on the map where it sits as you see it from your spot: during the leaderboard reveal the presenter window shows which way to look.
att_map_help: You are at the bottom, facing the room. Choose a team's Place on map, then click its spot; drag a team to move it.
att_place_hint: Click on the map where {team} sits (Esc cancels).
calib_circle: The blue circle must look round, not oval.
calib_corners: All four yellow corners must be fully visible.
calib_keys: Keys: +/− size · [ ] margin · 0 reset · F fullscreen · Esc close. Shift+C opens this screen anytime.
chk_abcd_answer: Answer “{answer}” must be A, B, C or D, otherwise nothing gets highlighted.
chk_duplicate_number: Question number {number} appears more than once in this round.
chk_handout_no_answer: No answer picture in the answer column: the reveal keeps showing the question picture.
chk_keys: ← → browse · Space switches question/answer · Esc closes
chk_long_text: Very long question ({length} characters): check that it fits on screen.
chk_media_kind: “{file}” does not look like the right kind of file for a {type} question.
chk_media_required: A {type} question needs a file in the last column (Zdroj).
chk_no_answer: No answer filled in: the reveal shows an empty answer.
chk_no_rounds: No rounds found. A round starts with a row whose first column says “Round 1 - Title” (or “Kolo 1 - Title”).
chk_no_scores: No scores Sheet: type the points into the score table (Scores button in the presenter window).
chk_no_teams: No teams yet: the welcome screen shows just the quiz name.
chk_numeric_answer: Numeric question, but the answer “{answer}” contains no number.
chk_round_hidden: This round is not shown in the show (its title contains TEST or KOLO X, or it has no questions).
chk_sort_bad_letters: The letters in the answer column ({letters}) must be A to {max}, each used once. Until then the show mixes the items itself.
chk_sort_count_high: Sort question has {count} items: at most {max} fit on screen.
chk_sort_count_low: Sort question has {count} item(s): it needs at least 2. Write them in the correct order, one per row: the item in column A, its letter in the answer column.
chk_sort_in_order: The letters go A, B, C… in the correct order, so the items are shown already sorted.
chk_sort_no_letters: No letters in the answer column, so the show mixes the items itself and the sheet does not show the answer. Move the items to column A and write these letters into the answer column, top to bottom: {letters}.
chk_sort_some_pictures: Only {count} of {total} items have a picture: the others are shown as empty picture cards.
chk_team_duplicate: Two teams are called {team}; scores can only belong to one of them.
chk_team_image_missing: Photo “{file}” of team {team} is not uploaded.
chk_top5_count: Top list has {count} answers; it needs 3 to 15.
chk_top5_declared: Marked Top{declared} in the Sheet but has {count} answers.
chk_type_unknown: Unknown type “{type}”: shown as a written-answer question.
chk_yesno_answer: Answer “{answer}” must be Yes or No, otherwise nothing gets highlighted.
cp_eyedropper: Pick a colour from the screen
ed_all_media: Every file the questions need is here.
ed_drive_replace: Some of these files are already in the media folder on Drive. Replace them with the new ones?
ed_drive_uploaded: {count} files uploaded to the media folder on Drive.
ed_err_format: The Sheet loaded, but it has no “Team Name” or “Název týmu” column. Is the link pointing to the right tab?
ed_err_http: Google returned an error for this link. Check that the link is complete and that the tab still exists.
ed_err_network: Could not load the Sheet. Check that it is shared as “Anyone with the link” (or published to the web) and that you are online.
ed_intro_help: Shown after the welcome screen, before the round overview. Turn either screen off if you do not need it.
ed_media_drop: Drop images, audio or video here, or a whole folder
ed_media_drop_drive: Drop images, audio or video here (or a whole folder) to upload them to the Zdroje folder on Drive
ed_media_help: File names must match the last column (Zdroj) of the questions sheet.
ed_no_rounds: No rounds found. Rounds start with a row whose first column says “Round 1 - Title” (or “Kolo 1 - Title”). A link without #gid=… reads the first tab of the spreadsheet.
ed_not_found: This quiz is not saved in this browser.
ed_prize_extra: Special prize (optional, e.g. for the last team)
ed_questions_help: Write the questions in Google Sheets using the template columns and paste the link here (Share → Anyone with the link), or upload a CSV file.
ed_refresh_drive: Load the latest version from Drive
ed_scores_drive: Read from the “{tab}” tab of the quiz Sheet with your Google sign-in, every 10 seconds during the show. No published link is needed.
ed_scores_help: A Google Sheet with a “Team Name” (or “Název týmu”) column and one column per round (“Round 1”, “Round 2”, … or “Kolo 1”, …), reloaded every 10 seconds during the show. Share it as Anyone with the link, paste the link of the scores tab and press Test.
ed_scores_manual_help: During the quiz, type each round's points into the score table (the Scores button in the presenter window, Enter jumps to the next team). Nothing to prepare.
ed_scores_unmatched_one: Matches no team: shown without a photo or colour
ed_sheet_auto: The questions are reloaded from the Sheet every time the show starts.
ed_theme_help: Colours, fonts, background and decorations of the show. Export a theme to share it, import one someone shared (a .zip with theme.json). The preview shows the round overview; the snow or bats run over every screen and almost disappear over questions and the leaderboard.
ed_warn_prizes: The prizes screen is on, but no prize is filled in.
ed_warn_scores: Paste the link to the scores Sheet, or choose typing the points in the app.
ed_warn_signin: Sign in with Google to load the latest version and save changes to Drive.
ed_warn_theme: Pick how the show looks. Classic is the usual dark look.
gd_beta_note: Available only to Google accounts invited by the maintainer of this app. Everything else works without it: create a quiz with New quiz and link a Google Sheet that is shared by link.
gd_create_help: Creates a folder with a copy of the template Sheet (scores and questions tabs) and an empty Zdroje folder, then opens it here. Invite the others from the setup page.
gd_duplicates: Several files in the media folder share these names, and Zdroj can only point to one of them: {names}.
gd_err_access: Not found, or not shared with you. Ask the owner to share the folder with {email}.
gd_err_auth: Your Google sign-in has expired. Sign in again and retry.
gd_err_bad_email: Google did not accept this address. Check that it belongs to a Google account.
gd_err_blocked: The app stopped a change outside this quiz's folder, so nothing was written. Please tell the app's author what you were doing.
gd_err_link: This is not a link to a Google Drive folder or a Google Sheet.
gd_err_no_folder: This quiz was opened from the Sheet alone, so there is no quiz folder to put media in. Open it from its Drive folder instead.
gd_err_no_sheet: There is no Google Sheet in this folder.
gd_err_readonly: You can view this Sheet but not edit it. Ask its owner for edit access.
gd_err_scope: Google did not give the app access to Drive. Sign in again and tick the Google Drive box.
gd_err_signin: Google did not complete the sign-in. The beta is limited to invited accounts: if the window said access is blocked, ask the maintainer to invite yours.
gd_err_template: The template Sheet could not be copied. Check that it is still shared by link.
gd_err_upload: You cannot add files to this quiz folder. Ask its owner for edit access.
gd_invite_message: You have been invited to work on a quiz in Quiz Night.
gd_invited: {email} can now open the quiz folder. Google has emailed them the link.
gd_new_parent: Folder to create it in (optional, otherwise My Drive)
gd_new_title: Quiz name, e.g. Quiz Night – October
gd_no_media_folder: No Zdroje (or source) folder next to the Sheet, so there is no media to download.
gd_offline_note: The downloaded media stays in this browser, so the show runs without the internet. The questions are read from the Sheet again when the show starts.
gd_open_help: Open a quiz straight from its Google Drive folder (the Sheet and the Zdroje folder), or from the Sheet's link. Only folders shared with your Google account can be opened.
gd_people_note: Editors can write questions and upload media; viewers can only look. Someone new to the app must also be added as a tester by its maintainer before they can sign in.
gd_people_readonly: Only people who may share this folder can invite others. Ask its owner.
gd_questions_note: The questions come from the Sheet on Google Drive. Change them with Edit questions, or straight in the Sheet and then sync.
gd_remove_confirm: Remove {name}'s access to the quiz folder?
gd_result: Questions updated. Media: {downloaded} downloaded, {kept} already up to date, {removed} removed.
gd_section_help: This quiz is read from Google Drive. Sync after changing the Sheet or the media folder.
gd_share_help: Send this link to the others: after signing in with Google they open the same quiz, with the same setup and teams. The folder must be shared with them.
inv_close: Not now, go to the quiz library
inv_note: Quiz Night uses Google sign-in only to open the quizzes shared with you. The first time, Google may say the app is not verified: it is a private beta, so choose Continue.
inv_opening_text: Signed in. Loading the questions, teams and setup from Google Drive.
inv_signed_as: Signed in as {email}. If the quiz was shared with another address, sign in with that one.
inv_text: Someone shared a Quiz Night quiz with you on Google Drive. Sign in with the Google account they invited, and the quiz opens by itself.
lb_done_note: The reveal is finished. Exit the leaderboard, or pick another round to reveal.
lb_empty_manual: Type the points into the score table (the Scores button at the bottom left), then press Reload scores.
lb_empty_sheet: No points were found in the scores Sheet. Check that the Sheet has a Team Name column and round columns, then press Reload scores.
lb_order_note: Each step adds one group's points. The teams keep their places until the last step, which re-sorts the table.
lb_reload_failed: The scores could not be loaded. The reveal uses the last scores read.
lb_reload_note: Reads the latest points and starts the reveal again
lb_scored_count: Only {n} of {total} teams have points in {round}. Is the round fully scored?
lb_scores_changed: The points changed after the reveal started. Press Reload scores to include them (the reveal starts again).
lb_signin: Live scores paused: sign in to Google
lb_signin_ending: Google sign-in ends in {n} min: renew it
lb_signin_needed: The scores Sheet needs a Google sign-in: it has expired, or nobody is signed in here. Questions and media keep working.
lib_delete_confirm: Delete this quiz and its media for good?
lib_empty: No quizzes of your own yet. Create one, import a package, or copy the demo.
lib_import_hint: Drop a quiz .zip, a folder, or questions.csv with its images here
lib_subtitle: Quizzes are saved in this browser only. Use Export to back them up or move them to another computer.
mp_edge_last: `→` after the last one, or `Esc` any time
mp_hub: The dashboard: the hub of the night
mp_hub_text: Every round, the leaderboard and half-time start from the dashboard and come back to it.
mp_intro: Every screen of this quiz in the order the night goes, and what takes you from one to the next. The presenter window shows the same screens with the controls and answers. Click a screen to see it large.
mp_key_c: `Shift+C` fits the picture to a new screen
mp_key_esc: `Esc` leaves a round or the leaderboard
mp_round_a: Answers: each question, then its answer
mp_round_q: Questions: the teams write their answers
next_finish: End the round and return to the overview
next_step: Show the next part (question, media, answer)
pause_trend_more: More rounds needed for the trend
qe_changed_by: {name} saved this question {time}, after you opened it. Their version:
qe_conflict: Someone changed this question in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Compare with their version above, then save again to keep yours.
qe_conflict_round: This round was changed in the meantime, so nothing was saved. The list now shows the latest version.
qe_correct_hint: Click a letter to mark the correct option.
qe_delete_confirm: Delete this question from the Sheet? You can still restore it from the Sheet's version history.
qe_editing_now: {names} is editing this question right now. Whoever saves second will be asked to compare.
qe_keep_mine: or save to replace it with yours
qe_letters_hint: Each item is shown on screen under its letter. The letters go into the answer column, so whoever marks the answer sheets can read the right order there.
qe_media_hint: Path in the Zdroje folder, e.g. kolo3/cat.jpg
qe_media_missing: Not among the synced media. Put the file into the Zdroje folder, then sync on the setup page.
qe_media_missing_upload: Not among the synced media. Upload it with the button, or drop the file here.
qe_not_drive: The question editor works with quizzes opened from Google Drive. Edit this quiz's questions in its Sheet or CSV.
qe_pick: Choose a question on the left, or add a new one.
qe_readonly: You can view this Sheet but not edit it. Ask its owner for edit access.
qe_signin: Sign in with Google to edit the questions in the Sheet.
qe_upload: Upload a file to the Zdroje folder
qe_upload_replace: {file} is already in the media folder. Replace it with the new file?
qs_csv_text: Fill in the CSV template in Excel or any spreadsheet, save it as CSV and upload it with the button above.
qs_examples_done: Example round loaded with its media. Press Start show to try it, or replace it with your own questions.
qs_examples_text: One round with an example of every question type, with a picture, sound and video, so you can try the show right away and replace them later.
qs_help: Every column and question type explained
qs_preview: This is how the questions sheet looks: one row per question, the columns in this order.
qs_sheet_text: Make your own copy of the template, write the questions, then Share → Anyone with the link and paste its link above. Typos can be fixed until the show starts.
qt_abcd_desc: Four options A–D; the correct one lights up at the reveal.
qt_audio_desc: A player under the question, e.g. for a song or a jingle.
qt_group_media: With a picture, sound or video
qt_handout_desc: A picture the teams also get on paper (a map, a collage, a crossword); the picture with the answers replaces it at the reveal.
qt_image_desc: The picture appears under the question and can be enlarged.
qt_numeric_desc: Like a written answer, but the answer is a number: a year, a count, an estimate.
qt_pimage_desc: The picture fills the screen first, then the question appears. Good for “what is this?” rounds.
qt_pvideo_desc: The video fills the screen and plays by itself, then the question appears.
qt_sort_desc: 2–10 items shown mixed up under letters; teams write the right order, e.g. C A D B.
qt_top5_desc: 3 to 15 hidden answers, e.g. the ten most common names, all revealed together. Longer lists are shown in two or three columns.
qt_video_desc: A video player under the question.
qt_written_desc: Teams write their answer; it is revealed afterwards.
qt_yesno_desc: Two tiles, Yes and No; the correct one lights up.
question: Question
rd_google_todo: Sign in to load and save
rule_2: The Quizmaster's word is law. Arguments will be penalized.
rule_3: Cheating results in immediate disqualification and public shame.
rule_4: Have fun, drink responsibly, and respect your rivals.
sc_help: Type each team's points per round. Enter moves to the next team. Changes are saved right away and the show's leaderboard updates by itself.
sc_sheet_linked: This quiz uses a Google Sheet for scores, so the points here are not used. Remove the Sheet link on the setup page to use this table.
set_layout_help: Cards show one team at a time with photo, motto and past results. The wall shows every team at once, for teams known only by name. Automatic picks the wall when fewer than half of the teams have a photo or motto.
set_sounds_none: This theme has no sounds. Themes with sounds play them for round titles, answers and the leaderboard.
sl_intro: The show runs in two windows: one on the TV for the audience, and one on your laptop to control it.
sl_keys: Keys in either window: `→` next, `←` back, `Esc` back to the rounds. In the TV window `Shift+P` opens the presenter and `Shift+C` fits the picture to a new screen.
sl_one_screen: Only one screen? Open the show in this window
sl_presenter_text: Stays on your laptop: it controls the TV and shows the answers, the timer and the scores.
sl_tv_blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups for this site and click again.
sl_tv_opened: Opened. Drag it to the TV or projector, click into it and press F11.
sl_tv_opened_screen: Opened on the second screen. Click into it and press F11.
sl_tv_text: Opens the show in a new window. Drag it to the TV or projector, click into it and press F11.
sort_hint: Write the letters in the correct order
te_c_accent_help: Buttons and highlights, with black text
te_c_ground_help: Behind the question and answer screens
te_celebration_help: Bursts over the TV when the leaderboard shows the final standings.
te_decoration_help: Runs over every screen of the TV, and almost disappears over questions and the leaderboard.
te_err_file_size: The file is too big (up to {size} MB).
te_err_file_type: This file can't be used here. Allowed: {types}.
te_glows_help: Soft coloured light behind the screens. Left–right and top–bottom place it, in percent of the screen.
te_lb_help: The preview shows the final standings. The reveal works the same in every layout; the podium, spotlight and medals appear for the final standings.
te_r_accent_text: Black text on highlight buttons is hard to read. Use a lighter highlight colour.
te_r_image: The picture is very visible, so text over it can be hard to read. Lower its visibility or blur it.
te_r_ok: Everything is easy to read, even from the back of the room.
te_r_primary_text: White text on main-colour buttons is hard to read. Use a darker main colour.
te_r_text_ground: White text is hard to read on this background from across a room. Make the background darker.
te_r_text_panel: White text is hard to read on the cards. Make the cards darker.
te_share_github: Submitting needs a free GitHub account. Only share pictures and fonts you may share.
te_share_go: Download the file and open the form
te_share_missing: Fill in the theme's name and author first: the workshop shows them.
te_share_readability: The readability check found something. Themes that are hard to read on a TV may not be accepted.
te_share_step1: The theme file downloads to your computer.
te_share_step2: A form on GitHub opens with the theme's name, author, description and tags filled in. Drag the downloaded file into it and submit.
te_share_step3: Once the theme has been looked at, it appears in the workshop for everyone.
te_sounds_help: Short sounds the app makes itself for round titles, answers and the leaderboard. The host can turn them down or off in the show settings.
te_style_help: The shape of every screen of the show.
te_tags_hint: christmas, calm… (Enter or comma adds one)
te_wl_help: On the team wall, the welcome screen for teams known by name.
thm_applied: Theme “{name}” is now used in this quiz.
thm_err_bad_json: theme.json could not be read: it is not valid JSON.
thm_err_no_theme: This file is not a theme. A theme is a .zip with theme.json inside, or theme.json alone.
thm_lib_delete_confirm: Remove “{name}” from My themes? Quizzes that use it keep their copy.
thm_library_help: Themes saved in this browser from the theme editor. Click one to use it in this quiz.
thm_new_confirm: This replaces the quiz's own theme “{name}”. Continue?
thm_p_color: The colour “{detail}” is not a #rrggbb colour.
thm_p_file_size: The file {detail} is too big (pictures up to 8 MB, fonts up to 2 MB).
thm_p_file_type: The file {detail} is not a supported type (pictures: jpg, png, webp, avif; fonts: woff2, woff, ttf, otf).
thm_p_font: The font “{detail}” is not one of the app's fonts. Add it to the pack as a font file.
thm_p_glows: Only the first 6 glows are used.
thm_p_missing_file: The file {detail} is not in the pack.
thm_p_unused_file: The file {detail} is not used by the theme.
thm_p_version: The theme was made for a newer version of the app; parts this version does not know were left out.
thm_problems: Some parts of the file were left out:
title: Quiz Night
tm_duplicate: Another team has the same name; scores can only belong to one of them.
tm_empty: No teams yet. Add them one by one, or import a CSV such as a Google Form registration export.
tm_err_no_history_columns: The file needs a team-name column and at least one column with “Rank” in its name.
tm_err_no_name_column: No team-name column found. The CSV needs a column like “Název týmu” or “Team name”.
tm_from_scores_done: {added} teams added from the scores Sheet, {existing} were already in the list.
tm_from_scores_need: Link a live scores Sheet above first.
tm_from_scores_none: The scores Sheet has no team names yet.
tm_from_sheet: The teams are the rows of the “{tab}” tab in the quiz Sheet, and changes go both ways: rename or remove a team here or there. A new team gets its row once its name is confirmed (Enter). Photos, mottos and the rest are saved in the quiz folder and stay with the team when it is renamed; a removed team keeps them too, and gets them back when its name is typed into the tab again.
tm_help: Shown on the welcome screen, the leaderboard and the half-time screen. Names must match the names in the scores.
tm_history_imported: Past results found for {matched} teams ({total} rows in the file).
tm_remove_confirm: Remove {name}? Their name is cleared from the “{tab}” tab; the row and its points stay. The photo and motto are kept and come back if the name is typed in again.
tr_answer_shown: `→` goes on to the next question. Press `Esc` when you have seen enough.
tr_answers: Once the answer sheets are collected, the round is gone through again with the answers. Point at the first round again and click Answers.
tr_back_to_dashboard: Press `Shift+D` to get back to the dashboard and carry on with the tour.
tr_dashboard: This is the dashboard, the hub of the night. Every round has two buttons: Questions, while the teams write their answers, and Answers, to go through the round again with the answers. Point at the first round to open it, then click Questions.
tr_done: That is a whole quiz night: the welcome, rounds of questions and answers, and the leaderboard reveal. Half-time on the dashboard opens a break screen with a timer. Ready to make your own quiz?
tr_lb_card: These teams scored the same in this round. Press `→` to add their points to the table.
tr_lb_points: Keep pressing `→`. The teams keep their places until the last step re-sorts the table into the new order. Press `Esc` when you are done.
tr_lb_start: The table shows the standings before this round. Press `→`: the teams are revealed by their points in the round, from the fewest.
tr_leaderboard: After a round is marked, click the ringed button to reveal the standings. The points come from the scores Sheet or the score table.
tr_presenter: On the night you run everything from your laptop while this window is on the TV. Press `Shift+P` to open the presenter window: it controls this screen and shows you the answers, the timer and the scores. Both windows stay in step.
tr_presenter_skip: I only have one screen, skip this
tr_prizes: What the best teams win. Click the ringed button to reach the dashboard.
tr_questions: The teams write their answers now. `→` shows the next question, `←` goes back and `Z` enlarges a picture. After the last question the show returns to the dashboard; press `Esc` to go back sooner.
tr_round_card: Each round starts with its title. Press `→` to show the first question.
tr_rules: The rules, shown before the first round. Click the ringed button to go on.
tr_welcome: This window is what the audience sees on the TV. The welcome screen introduces the teams while people arrive. Click the ringed button to begin.
wl_demo_text: Open the demo quiz with its TV window and presenter window and click through a round to see how a quiz night goes.
wl_import_text: Drop the .zip or folder they sent into the box below. A link to a shared quiz opens by itself.
wl_new_text: Start a new quiz. The setup page lists what it needs and can fill in example questions to begin with.
wl_text: Run a quiz night from the browser: the questions on the TV, the controls and answers on your laptop, the scores and a leaderboard reveal at the end. Nothing to install, and everything stays in this browser.
ws_error: The workshop could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
ws_intro: Themes made and shared by other quiz hosts. Each one was checked and looked at before it got here. Open one to see every screen of the show in it, then use it in one of your quizzes.
ws_no_quizzes: Make a quiz first to use a theme in it.
ws_pick_quiz: Quiz to use the theme in
ws_share_text: Make a theme in the theme editor of any of your quizzes and click Share to the workshop there.
